verdict.rationale: The API reference lists an endpoint to "Generate an accounts payable aging report" alongside a full bills workflow API, so AP aging is documented. Ask Digits answers questions about vendor history, and custom reports exist. However, the evidence never shows per-vendor balance views or the ability to run aging as of an arbitrary historical date, and AP aging appears only as an API endpoint title rather than a documented accountant-facing report. missing for 10: explicit as-of/point-in-time date selection, documented vendor balance reporting, in-app AP aging report documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
